WHAT EUROPE PRYKHYSTOK DOES
We cannot stop the war. But we can offer a few weeks of peace
Europe Prykhystok organises respite stays for groups of Ukrainian children in cities across Europe — two weeks away from sirens, fear, and the daily weight of living in a country at war. Two weeks of simply being young, in a place where that is still possible.
